positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented IPSec over TCP transport for the Core OS Networking team.
• Measured performance of implementation in a variety of configurations under different loads.
• Employed multiple network simulation tools to measure and understand interactions of IPSec over TCP  when operating in the presence of non-ideal network conditions.
• Collaborated with several teams to interpret results, resulting in changes to TCP implementation for Apple platforms.

positions.title: Vendor - Cisco Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented C++ utility to extract a Microsoft DHCP server configuration and produce a CLI script to configure a Cisco Prime Network Registrar DHCP server with equivalent network topology and features.
• Collaborated with another intern to create complete solution, converting configuration data and lease state database.
• Utility has been distributed to customers without further modification.

positions.title: Vendor - Cisco Intern
positions.description:
• Significant development of iOS Application for remote monitoring of Cisco Prime Network Registrar DHCP and DNS servers, used to demo product for internal and external trade shows, to be submitted to Cisco internal app store.
• Designed and implemented user interface, improved performance, internal data handling and interface with Highsoft’s Highcharts JS, updated and created new application artwork.
